featured_reviews.name: Mansha Pais
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been ordering meals from this place every day for the past month and it has been a consistently good experience. The portions are generous and they offer a nice variety like pav bhaji and puri bhaji on some days, to break the usual rice-and-dal routine. They even surprise you with a sweet dish occasionally. While the dry sabzi and gravy can be mildly spicy for some, the dal is exceptional and more than makes up for it. Delivery times can vary, but that is understandable given Santacruz East traffic. Overall, the food feels homely and I am more than happy to keep ordering from them.

The lady keeps cutting the phone, before we even ask her anything.

featured_reviews.review_text: I hv been ordering food since long here… food is completely home made n very tasty …. If u r searching for home made food then it is 100 on 100 experience…. The owner is very humble n cooperative…. Would thanks her to serve such a wonderful service!

featured_reviews.name: Anushka Rajesh
featured_reviews.review_text: Swad Kitchen is synonymous to simple and soulful food. I have personally tasted a lot of the dishes - be it rice dishes or roti-subzi dishes, and one thing that stands out is that the flavours taste like home and are super delicious! We also requested catering of Chinese cuisine for a party at our college for over 200 guests, and everyone had great feedback not only about the food but also the delivery, packing and other associated services. My friends, relatives, family and I also enjoy and vouch for the special sweets and snacks during festivals - we've tasted these during Diwali and absolutely love it!!

featured_reviews.name: Shital Baing
featured_reviews.review_text:
I must say, HealthBag Meal is one of the best food services I’ve come across. The meals are not only healthy but also incredibly tasty — every bite feels fresh and satisfying.

What makes it even more special is that my parents enjoy the meals too. It’s rare to find a service that appeals across generations, balancing nutrition with flavor so well. Their consistency, quality, and taste truly set them apart.

If you’re looking for a food service that combines health with taste and wins hearts in the family, HealthBag Meal is highly recommended!

featured_reviews.review_text:
I was very disappointed with the service provided by them. I ordered 2 meals for my elderly mother on a trial basis.The dinner was delivered at 21:30 instead 20:00. By then she had consumed food she had to
Manage by herself and the lunch they provided next was missing the dal and raita and they expected her to wait again so they could redeliver the missing food. This is the unprofessional service ever.

featured_reviews.name: Meher A.T. G
featured_reviews.review_text:
NOT RECOMMENDED! Today was the first day of my trial order. I had signed up for the full meal which was supposed to contain 2 vegetables, dal, rice, accompaniment and roti.
1) One vegetable was NOT SENT.
2) The other item sent as a vegetable was CHOLE! Is CHOLE A VEGETABLE?
3) After informing them that the second vegetable had not been sent, I was told it would be delivered in 10 minutes(I live close to the tiffin service place). It was delivered after almost an hour. Seems like the vegetable prepared for the day must have been over because what I received was PANEER BHURJI. AGAIN NOT A VEGETABLE!
4) The item sent as a dal was a WATERY KADHI with nothing in it. Is KADHI A DAL?

I AM EXTREMELY DISAPPOINTED with the food that has been sent.

The INFORMATION OF THE ITEMS IN THE MEAL IS MISLEADING ON THE WEBSITE.

Glad that I signed up for only the 5 days trial. I would NOT RECOMMEND this tiffin service

featured_reviews.name: AMAR BHARDE
featured_reviews.review_text: Whatever food charges displayed here are totally misleading. In each meal they add Rs. 40 as a delivery charge, though you agreed to pick it from them and not opting for delivery. That means Rs. 40 is hidden charges that they levy on each order.

featured_reviews.name: Renu Dodeja
featured_reviews.review_text: I received tiffin two days properly and on third day I received only sabzi and chapati was missing. I complained but no response received. I then stopped placing order but then too no action was taken. Pathetic service.

featured_reviews.name: anjali joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I highly recommend Health Bag Meal tiffin service! I ordered their tiffins for a month during a time when my husband and I were down with chicken gunya, and our cook was on long leave. Health Bag Meal truly was a lifesaver.

The food is hygienic, non-spicy, and absolutely delicious. Everything is delivered right to your doorstep in sealed bags, so there’s no spilling, mixing, or misplacement. The containers are microwave-safe, making it very convenient to reheat.

What impressed me most is the variety in the menu — no dish was repeated over the entire month! They also don’t use baking powder or baking soda, and we had zero digestion issues. The variety of vegetables and dals was particularly commendable.

Mr. Harish Sharma, the owner, is very courteous, always responds promptly and addresses the queries satisfactorily. On request, he provided vegetables without onion and garlic for my parents, and they loved them. On one occasion, there was a small mix-up in the order, but he promptly sent the correct vegetables again at no extra charge — a truly heartwarming gesture.

Overall, Health Bag Meal combines user-friendly, hygiene, and delicious home-style food with excellent customer service. I’ve already recommended them to many and I will continue to do so!

featured_reviews.name: Vidit Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been taking healthbag meal Tiffin services for more than 17 months and still their services as well as food quality remained top notch. Especially the owner Mr. Harish Sharma is such a generous person as he listens the customer request, complaints and he make sure that it will not be done in the near future. I would really recommend to opt for this tiffin services as in South Bombay you can’t get such a delicious homely cooked food at a quite decent price.

featured_reviews.name: Arya Shukla
featured_reviews.review_text: Very good homely food. The taste is very good, and it's comforting, will remind you of your mom's food. Great for people living away from home, very simple and clean, not spicy or oily at all. Also, the rate is very reasonable as compared to other tiffin services, and the customer service is really good. 10/10 recommended.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Perfect Tiffin Service for a Busy Lifestyle!
I’ve been using this tiffin service for the past few months, and it has truly been a blessing in my hectic schedule. With work and other daily responsibilities, I hardly had the time or energy to cook nutritious meals — that’s where this service came to the rescue.

The food is always fresh, homely, and full of variety. It reminds me of a proper ghar ka khana, which is hard to find these days. The quality and hygiene are top-notch, portions are satisfying, and delivery is always on time, which I really appreciate.

featured_reviews.review_text: They have a complete lack of communication. In March, my deliveries were already inconsistent, and only when I followed up did they mention an LPG crisis as the reason. featured_reviews.name: parul sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I just want to thank the entire Happy Grub team for the consistently hygienic and nutritious food.
Your staff was always prompt on calls and messages, and the food delivery was always on time. You made my stay in Mumbai easier and healthier.

featured_reviews.name: Devi Razdan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I discovered Happy Grub online and had the pleasure of speaking with Akash. He was incredibly helpful and knowledgeable, taking the time to answer all my queries and carefully noting my food intolerances.

​I decided to trial their "eco lunch" for a week, and I am beyond impressed. The food is:
fresh and nutritional, You can tell the ingredients are high-quality and flavoursome: Every meal truly hits the spot

​From the seamless delivery team to the final bite, everything has been top-tier. If you’re looking for a service that actually listens to your dietary requirements and delivers delicious results, I can’t recommend them enough. 5 stars!

featured_reviews.name: Bhawna Rathi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I ordered tiffin from this place and it sucks. I am paying so much for this lunch box but with hair sticking out of my food. This is ridiculous.
Another day, i open my box at 2 pm, only to find that there are no chapatis in my box and then you call them and this thing keeps happening but you really wont want to stay hungry at that time so its all a waste. Not ordering again and neither recommending it to anyone.
I was expecting a better service. The food is cold in itself but atleast they are supposed to send the complete meal.

featured_reviews.review_text: What a great service of food and the behind the back team customer care all are cooperative and well behaved they understand what customer pain and try to accommodate best possible delivery guy is great very rear to find such combination in today’s senareo great going and longing forward to opt more 🙏🙏🙂👍
